subfield: Quantum gravity and quantum field theory (theoretical high-energy physics)
motivation: In 1997 Maldacena conjectured that string theory in anti-de Sitter space is exactly equivalent to a conformal gauge theory on its boundary; Gubser, Klebanov and Polyakov, and independently Witten, turned this into a precise dictionary relating bulk fields to boundary correlators. The resulting holographic principle gave the first fully quantum, non-perturbative definition of gravity in a class of spacetimes, established that black hole evaporation is unitary, and showed that spacetime geometry can emerge from quantum entanglement. Beyond quantum gravity, the duality became a working tool across physics: it produced the universal shear viscosity bound tested against quark-gluon plasma at RHIC and the LHC, new approaches to strongly correlated electrons and non-Fermi liquids, and deep links to quantum information and error correction. Few ideas of the past half-century have reshaped so many areas of theoretical physics, or trained so many young theorists.
